stage: R2-S1 determinism, runtime, memory (FREEZE S1 / week4a-r2 §15)
_epistemic: PRE-C2.  S1 measures reproducibility of a model against ITSELF on identical input.  It says nothing about whether the prediction is correct, and a bitwise-deterministic model can be bitwise-deterministically wrong.

roles.wreck_05/f000109: lower-texture lateral glide / weak geometry support

subset.rationale: A representative subset, not the 288-frame benchmark. Determinism and runtime do not need the full set, and FREEZE S1 explicitly does not ask for it.

moge3_vitl.compared_field: canonical_range where the model emits one, otherwise the NATIVE field — so the floor is in the units the S2 alignment policy will actually work in
moge3_vitl.stochasticity_source: none observed — bitwise reproducible on this device and precision

noise_floor.meaning: Worst 99th-percentile RELATIVE difference between repeated runs on identical input. No downstream relative delta below this may be read as signal for this model.

moge3_vitl.grid: source grid 1280x720 = 921600 samples; the mask is the model's own, so the compared count varies with coverage
moge3_vitl.configuration: Step 0 (refine_steps = 0, refiner=None).  Step 3 was not measured -- see pending.moge3_vitl_step3.

pxdepth.note: Median 16.45 s/frame here against the 22.25-23.68 s/frame recorded in S3. The S3 figure is the one to quote for that stage -- it was measured under that stage's own load -- and the gap is machine contention, not a model difference. PXDepth is the only arm with no MPS path at all.

moge3_vitl_step3.stopped_at: S0 gate; the Step-3 refiner never became constructible on this machine
moge3_vitl_step3.reason: moge/model/modules/sparse_unet.py:14 requires flex_gemm.ops.NeighborCache; FlexGEMM is Triton-powered (pyproject: triton>=3.2.0) and Triton has no macOS distribution. No CUDA device on this machine.

surge_large.stopped_at: S0 gate, first sanity inference -- no S1-S6 stage was entered
surge_large.reason: SurGe's Neighborhood Attention has no backend that both runs on this machine and is numerically the released one. NATTEN refuses MPS outright and refuses compiled flex on two independent gates; the one sanctioned path, uncompiled CPU flex, was measured above to need ~138 GB of memory footprint and was killed by the OS at 931 s on a 24 GB machine.
surge_large.environment_required: one CUDA GPU with compute capability >= 7.0, so NATTEN selects a fused FNA backend instead of materialising the score matrix

hyden_mogev2_metric.stopped_at: S0 gate; checkpoint could not be obtained
hyden_mogev2_metric.reason: GatedRepoError 401: 'Cannot access gated repo ... Access to model facebook/hyden-mogev2-metric-point is restricted. You must have access to it and be authenticated to access it.' The repository requires a manually approved access request plus an authenticated HF token; no token exists on this machine and the execution policy forbids provisioning or authenticating to a service.

pointdit_l512.reason: The released PointDiT checkpoint is published WITHOUT the DINOv3 image encoder -- the filename says so ('nodinov3') and README:59-62 states 'The DINOv3 weights are gated and cannot be redistributed, so they are not part of the released checkpoints.' model.py:270 requires feature_embedding_type='dinov3_vitb16' and :305-317 loads pretrained/dinov3/dinov3_{vit_type}_pretrain_lvd1689m-{sha}.pth from a third_party/dinov3 checkout. Fetching those weights returns GatedRepoError 401 for facebook/dinov3-vitb16-pretrain-lvd1689m (gated: manual).
pointdit_l512.protocol_consequence: §15 requires the single-step all-zero-initialisation path to be tested DIRECTLY for determinism, because a diffusion-family model is the one challenger where stochastic initialisation is the expected failure.  That test is blocked, not passed, not skipped.

round1_incumbent_reference._note: Reproduced unchanged from results/S1_results.json for runtime/memory comparison only.  §13 forbids rerunning the incumbents, and determinism is a property of the model and device, not of the Part A/B/D corrections, which touched only post-inference semantics and grid mapping.
